faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Gilroy homeowners typically invest $4,000 to $9,500 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This South Valley city features a mix of older ranch homes near downtown and newer master-planned developments in the Glen Loma Ranch area. Standard sizing in newer developments makes for efficient, cost-effective projects. Single window installation starts at approximately $420.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Yes. Gilroy requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Gilroy Building Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Gilroy?
faq.answer: For Gilroy's hot inland South Valley climate, we most frequently install Anlin Del Mar triple-pane for superior heat rejection, Milgard Tuscany vinyl for cost-effective whole-home replacements, and Simonton for budget-conscious projects with solid energy performance.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Gilroy neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Gilroy areas including Glen Loma Ranch, Sunrise, Gavilan Hills, downtown Gilroy, and South Valley. Zip codes: 95020.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Gilroy?
faq.answer: Most Gilroy projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
